title: Hammer with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='48' rx='5' fill='#C97B3D'/>
  <!-- handle highlight -->
  <rect x='46' y='42' width='4' height='48' rx='2' fill='#E8A86D'/>
  <!-- handle bottom cap -->
  <rect x='42' y='84' width='16' height='8' rx='4' fill='#A05A22'/>

  <!-- hammer head main body -->
  <rect x='18' y='18' width='64' height='30' rx='7' fill='#8C9BAA'/>
  <!-- hammer head top highlight -->
  <rect x='22' y='20' width='56' height='8' rx='4' fill='#B8C8D8'/>
  <!-- hammer head lighter face area (for the smiling face) -->
  <rect x='28' y='28' width='44' height='16' rx='5' fill='#D8E4EE'/>

  <!-- left claw/peen -->
  <path d='M18 22 Q8 24 8 33 Q8 42 18 44 Z' fill='#6E7E8E'/>
  <path d='M18 24 Q11 26 11 33 Q11 40 18 42 Z' fill='#A8B8C8'/>

  <!-- right claw/peen -->
  <path d='M82 22 Q92 24 92 33 Q92 42 82 44 Z' fill='#6E7E8E'/>
  <path d='M82 24 Q89 26 89 33 Q89 40 82 42 Z' fill='#A8B8C8'/>

  <!-- smiling face on the lighter area -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#2E3D4D'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#2E3D4D'/>
  <!-- eye shines -->
  <circle cx='41.2' cy='32.8' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61.2' cy='32.8' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 40 Q50 47 58 40' stroke='#2E3D4D' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#F2A0A0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#F2A0A0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- little shine on hammer head -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='24' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
